crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software development grounds indexing/search implementation but not relevance policy or domain truth.

crosswalks.label: Data Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Data-science work contributes model/evaluation methods without owning product ranking policy.

crosswalks.rationale: Research-science work provides adjacent algorithm/search research context but not production retrieval ownership.

findings.summary: Information retrieval spans software, data/model evaluation and information-research work; proxy relevance, source truth and product ranking objectives must stay distinct.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialization boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make offline retrieval metrics, source truth and product/user relevance authority separate evidence surfaces.
